votes.motion: Approve the Work Session meeting minutes of Tuesday, November 17, 2020; Tuesday, December 8, 2020 and the Limited Formal Meeting Minutes of Thursday, May 13, 2021.
votes.description: Approval of past work session and limited formal meeting minutes from November 2020, December 2020, and May 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Resolution for Issuance of Series 2021 Bonds for Financing the Construction of the New SLC International Airport.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a resolution authorizing the sale of up to $1 billion in Airport Revenue Bonds to finance construction of the new Salt Lake City International Airport.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance for Rezone at Approximately 860 and 868 East 3rd Avenue.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from CN and SR-1A to R-MU-35 for properties at 860 and 868 East 3rd Avenue and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance for Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 850 and 870 East 2100 South.
votes.description: Closes the initial public hearing on a proposed rezone from CC to CSHBD2 and Sugar House Master Plan amendment for properties at 850 and 870 East 2100 South and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Reopen the public hearing for agenda item B-3 – Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 850 East 2100 South.
votes.description: Reopens the public hearing for the rezone and master plan amendment at 850 and 870 East 2100 South due to internet connectivity issues that prevented some participants from attending earlier.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future meeting on the Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 850 and 870 East 2100 South.
votes.description: Closes the reopened public hearing on the rezone and master plan amendment at 850 and 870 East 2100 South and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting on the Ordinance for Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 810 East 800 South.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on a proposed rezone from R-2 to CB and Central Community Future Land Use Map amendment for the property at 810 East 800 South and defers action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Continue the public hearing on the Resolution for Capital Improvement Program Projects to August 17, 2021.
votes.description: Continues the public hearing on FY2022 Capital Improvement Program project funding allocations to a second hearing date of August 17, 2021.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 35 of 2021 setting the Consolidated Fee Schedule for Fiscal Year 2021-2022.
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts the ordinance amending various fees in the Salt Lake City Consolidated Fee Schedule for FY2021-22.

votes.motion: Ratify the Chair's determination to meet without an anchor location due to health and safety risk of those in attendance.
votes.description: Ratifies the Chair's decision to continue holding meetings remotely and without an anchor location due to ongoing health and safety concerns and the closure of the City and County Building to the public.

Approves all consent agenda items including setting public hearing dates, confirming hearing dates, and approving board appointments for Patrick Casey and Samantha Janse to the Bicycle Advisory Committee.
